title: Inertia of a pair bound through the field

key_results.statement: In the sector $P$ (body 1 as representative, continued to real $P$) the band contract at order $\tau^2$ is the relative chain $h_P$ with bond amplitudes $t(\rho;P)=\kappa_1(\rho)e^{-2iP}+\kappa_2(\rho)$; $r$ even and $r$ odd form separate rings.
At leading order in $\varepsilon$, $M^{(2)}(r)=-2ng_1g_2\ell(r)/t_f$ and the relative potential is $V(r)=\frac{ng_1g_2}{t_fL}r(L-r)$: a well at contact for $g_1g_2>0$, a hill for $g_1g_2<0$.

Under R and $\chi L^3\gg1$, for every branch combination and both signs of $\gamma_1\gamma_2$, bound levels exist (lowest if $\sigma_1\sigma_2\gamma_1\gamma_2>0$, highest if $<0$); the selected level (extreme level at the $k=0$ edge, bodies near rest: lowest if $s_\mu=+1$, highest if $s_\mu=-1$) is bound iff $s_\beta=\mathrm{sgn}[g_1g_2(\mu_1^{-1}+\mu_2^{-1})]=+1$, and then $f_0>0$ on the whole relative ring.

Selected level, $s_\beta=+1$, weak binding $F\ll|\bar t(P)|$, leading order: $E_b(P)=E_1(0)+E_2(0)-E_\varnothing+M(0)-2\bar t_0+s_e[-2|\bar t(P)|+a_0(4|\bar t(P)|F^2)^{1/3}]$, $a_0=1.0188$ the first zero of $\mathrm{Ai}'$, up to $O(\chi^{2/3})$ and $O(\xi_0/L)$.
For the selected level: bond weights $b_0(\rho)=f_0(\rho-1)f_0(\rho+1)>0$, bond overlap $\beta_0=\sum_\rho b_0(\rho)\in(0,1)$, local pair inertia $m(\rho)=-1/(8\kappa_1(\rho))-1/(8\kappa_2(\rho))$.

Exactly for the band contract at order $\tau^2$: $E_b''(0)=E''_{\rm line}(1+\rho_L)$ with $E''_{\rm line}=\sum_\rho b_0(\rho)/m(\rho)$ and the ring remainder $\rho_L$; since $b_0>0$, $E''_{\rm line}$ can vanish only if $m(\rho)$ changes sign along the ring, which B2 excludes.

$m(\rho)=\mu_1+\mu_2+s_c\bar M^{(2)}(\rho)(c_1^{-2}+c_2^{-2})+O(\varepsilon^3(|\mu_1|+|\mu_2|))$: the mutual term enters each body's inertia once over its own speed squared, with $s_c=+1$ for (a) and $-1$ for (c).

Under B2 ($\bar x\ll1$, implying $|A_0|\ll|\mu_1+\mu_2|\beta_0$): $1/E_b''(0)-\mu_1-\mu_2=(\mu_1+\mu_2)(1-\beta_0)/\beta_0+D^{\rm mark}_0-\rho_L/E''_{\rm line}$ up to $O(\varepsilon^3/\beta_0,\bar x^2/\beta_0)$; the lattice part is nonzero with the sign of $\mu_1+\mu_2$; $\beta_0\simeq1-0.270\chi^{2/3}$ (weak), $1/\chi$ (even, tight), $1/2$ (odd, tight); outside B2 only unexpanded (6.6).

The cost of the bound pair (pair level minus one-body levels plus field alone) is $\Delta E_0=\langle M\rangle_0+K_0$ with the relative kinetic cost $K_0=2\bar t_0(\beta_0-1)$ of sign $s_\mu$, at order $\tau^2$ through $\varepsilon^2$.

Selected level, leading order, both couplings, under R and B: $1/E_b''(0)-\mu_1-\mu_2=\Delta E_0/c^2$ is not an identity on the class for any $c\ge\min(c_1,c_2)$; the coefficients of $K_0$ and of $M(0)$ differ, and the relation fails in every description of case (i) of (6.17).
Weight of the bound level: $W_0(X)=\sum_rf_0(r)^2W_{\rm pair}(X-r/2,X+r/2)$ at first order in $g_s$.
For a distant source, at first order in $g_i$ and $g_s$: $W_0(X+1)-W_0(X-1)=n(g_1+g_2)[\phi(X+1)-\phi(X-1)]+O(\varepsilon^2g_s)$, the weight difference of the members.

(7.7) of 06-ilang-source/07-dressed-fall carries over to the bound level for the centre $\hat Y$ of (6.18): $a_0(0)=-E''_{\rm line}\sum_X\varphi_X^2W'_0(X)[1+O(w^{-2})]+O(\varepsilon^2g_sE''_{\rm line})+O(\tau^4\gamma g_s)$ on the line, informative under (N); the first form with the $b_0/m$-average of $(\partial_1+\partial_2)W_{\rm pair}$ holds also for $g_1+g_2=0$.

$\Pi_0=\frac{\beta_0}{\mu_1+\mu_2}[(\mu_1\Pi_1+\mu_2\Pi_2)(1+O(\bar x))+O(\varepsilon^2g_s)]$; under (N) $|g_1+g_2|\gg\varepsilon\max|g_i|$ the relative form holds, and under $\gamma_1c_1^2=\gamma_2c_2^2$ $\Pi_0-\Pi_1=-(1-\beta_0)\Pi_1$ at leading order; for $g_1+g_2=0$, $\Pi_0$ is of second order (value not determined) and differs from each $\Pi_i$ at first order.

At fixed $n,\gamma_i,M_i,\tau_i$: $\chi\propto1/t_f$, $1-\beta_0\simeq0.270\chi^{2/3}$, mark terms and the mark part of $\bar x$ fall as $1/t_f$; R1 excludes for $\sigma_i=+1$ the $t_f$ at which a field excitation lies within $\delta_1$ of $2R_i$; $\tau'^2/(\delta_1\delta)\ll1\ll\chi L^3$; no $t_f$ removes (6.10), (6.14).

Ring remainder bound: $|\rho_L|\le\tilde\Phi'(0)^2[2|s_*b_0|+4s_*^2(f_0(r_*)^2+f_0(r_*+2)^2)/\Delta_0]/|E''_{\rm line}|$ at the bond farthest from contact, exponentially small in $L/\xi_0$; $E_b''(0)$ is independent of the continuation to relative accuracy $|\rho_L|$.

Selected level, leading order, under B2, every $c\ge\min(c_1,c_2)$: if $s_c=-\sigma_1\sigma_2$, then $1/E_b''(0)-\mu_1-\mu_2\neq\Delta E_0/c^2$ (under (S) and B4); if $s_c=\sigma_1\sigma_2$, equality holds where the two leading terms cancel (codimension one), found for the leading-order expressions along a family satisfying R with hierarchy (H) and B, unverified in the full contract.

On the line the plane-wave label $P$ of the bound band is conjugate to the centre $Y=\frac{j+l}{2}+\theta'(l-j)=\frac{\mu_1j+\mu_2l}{\mu_1+\mu_2}+O(\varepsilon^2|l-j|)$; the projected source with $P$-dependent profile has the weight differences of $W_0$ up to $O(\varepsilon^2g_s)$ and relative $O(w^{-2})$.

open_issues: Bound levels with s_β=−1 and excited bound levels are out of scope for items 2–5 (note of 2026-10-21); (6.6) holds for them, but their inertia, cost and fall are not derived.
Outside B2 (near μ_1+μ_2=0, σ_1=−σ_2) only the unexpanded (6.6) is available; the cost comparison and the fall factor there are not derived.
The code sets do not meet B4 for the mark terms (|ρ_L| = 0.2–12% against |D^mark| ≈ 0.2–0.3% of 1/E_b''); the code checks (6.6) with the ring term included.
The closed forms (6.2), (6.4), (6.15), (6.17) use the second-order mutual term; at η≈0.3 the exact binding slope is about half of F; statements in terms of β_0, b_0 and M are unaffected.
The O(ε³) remainder of (6.7) is large at moderate couplings (ratio 1.40 for (a), −0.19 for (c) at η≈0.3), so the mark part is reliable only for small η.

The second-order corrections of (6.13), (6.14) are not evaluated (the bond function B of (4.7) is not quoted); 13–16% in the weight differences in the code; for g_1+g_2=0 (set D) the second-order fall is not given by the factorized form (factor 2.0–2.2).
On the ring, (6.13) has a g_s-independent part from the relative cut r=L/2 (up to 0.6% of the first-order part in set A); it is not bounded analytically.
In tight binding of the even class β_0∼1/χ and B3 fails when χ ≳ δ_1δ/τ'²; the order-τ⁴ band contract is then needed.
For σ_i=+1 and N_f>1 the field excitation energies near 2R_i become dense and the windows of (6.15) shrink; whether weakly coupled resonances can be tolerated is open.

The equality family of (6.17)(ii) is unverified in the full contract: it needs the remainders of (2.14), (2.16), (4.3) uniformly in n, L, t_f → ∞, and was checked only on the leading-order line chain.
Out of scope: full grip, tori, highest field state, bodies of one type, the speed of a front of the field, and how typical the structure is.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions: μ_i, m, 1/E_b'', M̄/c², μ_1μ_2K_0 have [C]^-1; Π_0, Π_i and the acceleration a_0(0) have [C]²; β_0, χ, ρ_L, x̄ are pure numbers
Unbound limit χ→0 on the line: β_0→1 and 1/E_b''→μ_1+μ_2, the curvature of E_1(p_1)+E_2(p_2) at fixed p_1+p_2 at p_i=0
Tight binding χ→∞: even class E_b''≈s_e·8κ̄_1κ̄_2/F and odd class 1/E_b''=2(μ_1+μ_2), equal to direct perturbation of the contact states
